# Hoppo

> Hoppo is a free parenting app and website for families from pregnancy to age 10. It gives one small skill to practise each week, milestones with keepsake cards, a pregnancy view week by week, and short practical guides.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://hoppoapp.com/): what Hoppo does and how it works
- [Guides](https://hoppoapp.com/guides.html): 55 short "Is this normal?" guides covering what is common, what can help and when to talk to a doctor, midwife or health visitor
- [Blog](https://hoppoapp.com/blog.html): 20 researched articles for parents, from the first weeks to age 10
- [Marketplace](https://hoppoapp.com/shop.html): family products from Hoppo and partner shops
- [Partners](https://hoppoapp.com/partners.html): how shops can join the Hoppo Marketplace
- [Support](https://hoppoapp.com/support.html): answers to common questions about the app
- [Privacy](https://hoppoapp.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://hoppoapp.com/terms.html)

## Languages

Every page is available in 11 languages. English is at the root. Other languages use a folder:

- English: https://hoppoapp.com/
- Deutsch: https://hoppoapp.com/de/
- Español: https://hoppoapp.com/es/
- Français: https://hoppoapp.com/fr/
- Hrvatski: https://hoppoapp.com/hr/
- Italiano: https://hoppoapp.com/it/
- Nederlands: https://hoppoapp.com/nl/
- Polski: https://hoppoapp.com/pl/
- Português: https://hoppoapp.com/pt/
- Română: https://hoppoapp.com/ro/
- Slovenščina: https://hoppoapp.com/sl/

## Notes

- Guides and articles are general information for parents and are not medical advice.
